description:
Watch a public HTTP endpoint or MCP server on a recurring schedule, privately.
    Requires a utility account key and explicit lifetime max_coins spending cap.
    Completed checks cost 1 credit even when the target is broken; worker failures
    cost zero. Minimum interval 300s; default hourly. Stops at budget/balance limit.
    Save/reuse request_key on uncertain retries. Nothing starts unless confirm=true.
    Optional public HTTPS webhook receives signed transition alerts; save its secret.
    MCP checks perform initialize/tools-list, save a baseline and flag schema drift.
    Scheduling is best effort, not real-time. Read pricing and obtain owner consent.
name: create_diagnostic_watch
